title: Scrimmage --json output, version 1
description: The one JSON document a scrimmage command prints with --json. Every command's document starts with the same envelope. Within version 1, fields and enum values are only added, so this schema is open: an unknown field, and an unknown value of a field that lists its values, both fit. A reader ignores a field it does not know and reads such a value as other.

message.description: The line's text, without its prefix. It can change in any release; do not match on it.

anyOf.$comment: open: a value this release does not know; read as other

records.description: The folder that holds this test's records, or null when none was made.

anyOf.$comment: open: a value this release does not know; read as other

runs_sent.description: A service test only: the requests the runner sent to the service, the setup request and every run.

claims_received.description: A service test only: the claims the control server answered. Far below runs_sent means no service reached the control server.

control_cut.description: A service test only: the control server's connections the read or whole-request timeouts cut. Near zero in a healthy test.

control_tls_failed.description: A service test only; empty without control_tls: connections that failed TLS, counted by OpenSSL's reason, such as unknown ca.

control_ping.description: A service test only: what the service's signed ping to the control server found before the first run, as its startup report gave it. Present in every finished service test; a test that stops at the probe or the ping has none, and gives the reason in infra.

result_file.description: The result.json written into the records folder: this document, but for this field. Null when it was not written, or when the test did not finish.

compare.description: The comparison with the earlier test named by --compare, or null.

expect.description: The fault's own expect, or null when it uses the test's.

forbid.description: The fault's own forbid, or null when it uses the test's.

pass_rate.description: The fault's own pass_rate, or null when it uses the test's.

anyOf.$comment: open: a value this release does not know; read as other
open: a value this release does not know; read as other

test_sha256.description: A hash of what this row was tested by: the question, the rules that judge the row, the mocks, run_timeout, real and tools. Not the agent's code.

test_sha256_v.description: The format of test_sha256. A comparison across two formats cannot tell whether the test changed.

control_busy.description: The sum over the row's runs of each run's control_busy; null when no run reported one.

control_p99_ms.description: The largest control_p99_ms of the row's runs; null when no run reported one.

anyOf.$comment: open: a value this release does not know; read as other

control_busy.description: Control requests the process that served the run refused itself, for no free slot of its 8, from the run's claim to its close. It describes the process: two runs in one worker count the same requests.

control_p99_ms.description: The 99th percentile round trip of that process's control requests in the same window, in milliseconds; null when there were none.

anyOf.$comment: open: a value this release does not know; read as other

real.description: The labels under [agent] real, as the file writes them.

value.description: The function, the command line, or the service's address, as the file names it.

entry.description: The entry point a test would start.

prices.description: Each model [agent.prices] prices, in dollars per million tokens. Any other model is priced from Scrimmage's built-in table.

service.description: What `scrimmage check --service` read from the service. Present only with --service, and only when the service answered as a gated one.

url.description: The service's address, as the file writes it.

gates.description: The entry gates installed in the process that answered, such as asgi.

sdk.description: The version of scrimmage in the service.

runner_sdk.description: The version of scrimmage in the command.

tools.description: The tools the service's gates swap.

tools_match.description: The service gates exactly the tools the file lists.

control.description: The service's ping to the control server, as the startup report holds it.

clock_gap_s.description: The service's clock less this machine's, in seconds; positive when the service is ahead.

warnings.description: Where the file's body does not fit the service's /openapi.json.

notes.description: What the check could not do, such as no document found.

notices.description: The notices the service held when it answered.

open: a value this release does not know; read as other

out.description: The file written, whole, or null when nothing was written.

records.description: The folder that holds this record's run, or null when no run started.

budget_usd.description: The cost cap used, or null when the budget is off or no run started.

anyOf.$comment: open: a value this release does not know; read as other

stopped_by.description: The reason a refusal stopped the record, as in scrimmage test, or null.

runs.description: The runs of each test that --runs asked for.

runs_recorded.description: The runs whose calls were read, in tests with nothing wrong.

argument_sets_seen.description: The distinct tool and MCP calls, by label and arguments, that ran for real.

argument_sets_written.description: Of those, the ones with a mock of their own.

mocks_text.description: The mocks, when the file's layout could not take them.

anyOf.$comment: open: a value this release does not know; read as other

out.description: The file written. Null means nothing was written.

guess.description: True when init chose the entry point by reading the code. A guess is never run.

function.description: The function --probe named, which is the only one a probe runs.

result.description: The folder's result.json, or null when it has none.

runs.description: The runs shown: the first failing run of each failing row, or the one run --run named.

anyOf.$comment: open: a value this release does not know; read as other

key.description: The key a value was under, or null for a pattern match in plain text.

anyOf.$comment: open: a value this release does not know; read as other

rule.description: pattern: the existing redaction; key_name: the key-name heuristic.

runs.description: How many runs saw this mock's key.

open: a value this release does not know; read as other

instead.description: The mock written in this call's place, so it needs nothing from the team, or null.

runs.description: One entry per run, in the order the runs were submitted.

not_started.description: Runs of the number asked for that never started, for any cause.

argument_sets.description: Per tool or MCP label that ran for real, how its calls split by arguments. No argument value is in it.

seen.description: The distinct sets of arguments this label was called with.

written.description: Of those, the sets with a mock of their own.

mock.description: The mock's place among the output test's mocks, from 1, or null.

code.description: The code it is listed with, or null.

seen.$comment: display text, cleaned by a heuristic; do not parse it

args.$comment: display text; do not parse it

earlier_scrimmage.description: The Scrimmage version that made the earlier result.

rows_compared.description: How many rows are listed, new and gone ones included.

rows.description: Rows whose result went from pass to fail first, then the rest.

timeline_line.description: One call in a run, in the order it started.

ms.description: Milliseconds from the run's first line.

anyOf.$comment: open: a value this release does not know; read as other

came_back.description: The call's error, or its result preview, with secrets removed.

depth.description: 1 or more for a call made inside another, such as a web request in a tool.

mock_miss.description: True when the call had a mock on its label and matched none.

outcome.description: How the run ended, or null when its record has no summary line.

lines_left_out.description: How many more calls the record holds than lines lists.

log_tail.description: For a run that crashed or timed out, the last line of its log.

suggestions.description: Heuristic suggestions for a failing run: the main one first, then at most one about a mock that missed. Empty for a pass, and when no rule fits.

suggestion.description: A heuristic rule over a run's record. It names no cause: its text says what came after what. Read code, never the text.

anyOf.$comment: open: a value this release does not know; read as other

evidence.description: What the rule read: a record line by seq and proc, or the run's summary line as {summary: true}.

proc.description: The process that wrote the line, as the record gives it.

summary.description: The rule read the run's summary line: its outcome, verdict or broken rules.

compare_row.description: One row of the comparison. Rows are matched by their test and their fault, never by name: a row's name is its place.

fault.description: The row's fault with every null field left out, or null on a baseline.

n.description: The row's place among the test's rows with an identical fault.

row_before.description: The row's name in the earlier test.

row_after.description: The row's name in the later test.

anyOf.$comment: open: a value this release does not know; read as other

before.description: That side's row as the test printed it, or null when the row is on the other side only.

anyOf.$comment: open: a value this release does not know; read as other

after.description: That side's row as the test printed it, or null when the row is on the other side only.

difference.description: After minus before, with a 95% interval (Newcombe's method 10, from the two Wilson ranges). Null when the rows cannot be compared by rate.

anyOf.$comment: open: a value this release does not know; read as other

change.description: better: the interval is above 0. worse: below 0. unclear: it holds 0, so these runs cannot tell the rates apart. no result: a side has too few judged runs, or is a fault row beside a failed baseline. new, gone: the row is on one side only.

result_change.description: The judge's result on each side, such as pass -> fail.

test_changed.description: True when the test's hash differs, so a change in rate may come from the test. Null when the hashes cannot be compared.
